Editing Details:

I can’t believe this is the 17th Taken 4 dream trailer in the channel. This shows how much the fans really want to see Liam Neeson return as Bryan Mills. Even though I’m not a big fan of the franchise because of its action scenes, I begin to understand how much beloved this franchise is so I have nothing but respect to the franchise that made Liam Neeson a household name. For the 17th dream trailer I wanted to continue the plot of Bryan Mills getting framed.

While I was editing I was watching interviews of the cast. And for the first time I made a scene of Bryan Mills attending his wife’s grave. The interview I watched talked about how he lost his wife in the last film, which made me think of the idea to begin the trailer like that. Editing a tombstone picture was a good addition, since I could not find info about Lenore Mills birthday I simply put the actress birthday then for her last day on earth the date of the release of Taken 3 January 9 2015.

Because this franchise is popular in the channel, I hired the best and most pricey news anchor on fiverr so there is a sense of new version improvement. Using green screen effect I made Micheal Keaton watch the news in Tv and Liam Neeson in billboard. I chose the song My W4y because its the perfect to convey some drama and at the same time action, and perfect fit to be the final Bryan Mills adventure. One great clip connection is Pierce Brosnan talking to Liam, since his character is good cop helping our hero I made them talk how they could bring the bad guy to justice.
